summary: Example EXOS-API task runs show version, with proxy_env from group_vars passed to the task environment.
questions: How do I pass the proxy to an EXOS-API task?

answer_card.title: EXOS-API task with proxy
answer_card.answer_md: Same `exos_command` task (`commands: show version`); add `environment: "{{ proxy_env }}"` so the proxy defined in `group_vars` is used by the module.
